items.title: Keep complete Git inventories within an explicit shared capture bound
items.insight: Required native source294 failed resync-derived self-test with git ls-files -z ENOBUFS. The same default1MiB cap affects full staging inventory capture. Current actual inventory exceeds1MiB; changing caller after caller leaves the common failure intact. Maintainers can verify and stage the full source tree without truncation, lost paths or bypassing checks.
items.evidence: Shared captured Git stdout equals an explicit16MiB native control on the complete real inventory. Explicit smaller capacity still fails closed. Non-Git output keeps the native default. Existing safe-spawn/window guard tests, resync self-test and independent review pass.
